purpose_notes: Use the same predeclared plateau interval for all cells; fit only B0 and fixed classical, not changing causal requests
Fit early3.0..5.4, evaluate later5.4..7.4; this is a correlated within-run time block, not independent validation
Tau is error relaxation time, not command deadtime; the grid is a bounded diagnostic search, not a measured physical range
SSE profile band is not a confidence interval; a fixed reference cannot separate static affine gain from bias
Keep whole14s native primary and GT grids unchanged; additive decomposition components are not independent causal contributions
Read only stored simulation diagnostics; reconstructed PI integral is an algorithm-state proxy, not torque measured on hardware
